high_level_description: The image shows a person taking a mirror selfie in what appears to be a dressing room or changing area. They are wearing a blue button-up shirt with the sleeves rolled up to the elbows and dark blue jeans. A silver chain necklace is visible around their neck, and they have a watch on their left wrist.
